data.title: 信浓 · 拨正旧观星镜的旋钮
data.description: 屋顶观星台的旧铜镜筒转得很慢。信浓扶稳镜架，轻拧旋钮，等视野里最亮的一点不再抖动。足踝附近的墨紫袍尾被风掀起，紫藤和银线星群随着衣褶展开，白绸内搭与同色长裙依然完整。
data.location: 圆顶观星台外侧的旧铜望远镜旁
data.action: 扶稳望远镜支架，慢慢拨动镜筒焦距旋钮
data.lighting: 远处星光冷淡，观星台低位灯微亮衣袍上的银线
data.camera: 平视斜侧中全景，望远镜与袍尾分占两侧
data.promptProse: Shinano steadies an old brass telescope and turns its focus knob slowly on the rooftop observatory. Wisteria and silver constellations are stitched into her midnight-purple open chiffon robe, worn over a fully opaque white silk top and matching ankle-length skirt. A low lamp picks out the silver threads as the hem lifts in the breeze.
data.animaCaption: One hand steadies the telescope while the other turns the brass focus knob, the embroidered train of her robe drifting behind.
